story: The stage featured a fast start with XDS-Astana controlling the race to gather points and bonus seconds at intermediate sprints. After the intermediate sprints, van Bekkum initiated a breakaway, joined briefly by Nencini and Masciarelli before they were dropped. Konychev later bridged to the lead group but was caught in the final kilometers. The stage concluded with a mass sprint victory by Macias, narrowly beating Nencini and Salby with a decisive bike throw.
